posts.post:
everyone has that one piece of clothing they’ve repaired twice instead of just replacing it. 

it’s usually the best thing they own.

we spent three hours trying to convince ourselves to add an interior chest pocket. 

removed it. nobody actually keeps anything in there.
the best outfits aren't designed. they’re just layers added until you don't feel like you're missing anything.

buying clothes for the office and buying clothes for the weekend. 

the lines are blurring and it’s about time.
